product.name: Squatch Limiter
product.description: Lookahead true-peak limiter: neither the samples nor the waveform between them go over the ceiling.

params.name: Ceiling
params.note: True-peak ceiling, dBTP. Applies at once; the final clamp covers the lookahead already in flight. The browser rig's range (-12..0) is inside this one.

params.name: Release
params.note: Time constant of the gain's recovery. The default is the browser rig's (120 ms; this block had 50 before parity fixes 2).

params.name: Drive
params.note: Gain before the limiter. The browser rig called this key `gain`.

params.name: Output
params.note: Trim after the limiter. It only attenuates, so the output never exceeds the ceiling.

params.name: Bypass
params.note: CLAP polarity: 1 means bypassed. The bypassed signal is delayed by the lookahead, so it stays aligned.
